text:
QUOTE: Results go to `event_queue_` under `event_mutex_` and are drained on the engine thread by `process_events()` (`:118`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the health monitor queues events under a mutex and that the engine thread drains them via `process_events()`. That is the substance of the item, though it never says in so many words that the callback is not invoked from the monitor thread.
